title: FairPump
tagline: FairPump is a platform for launching and trading meme coins on EVM-compatible blockchains. It allows users to create and deploy new coins without providing seed liquidity, preventing rug pulls and making it easier for anyone to launch a new token.
description: Our project utilizes a smart contract with an exponential bonding curve, allowing the deployment of tokens without the need for initial liquidity. This mechanism makes each token more appealing to retail investors. On the frontend, users can seamlessly launch their token by simply providing a name, ticker, description, and JPEG image. Once created, trading can commence immediately. When the combined liquidity reaches 10 Ether, all liquidity is added to a Uniswap V2 pool, ensuring a stable and robust trading environment.
how_its_made: FairPump project leverages Solidity for smart contracts, implementing an exponential bonding curve to enable token deployment without initial liquidity. The frontend, built with React and Web3.js, allows users to easily create tokens by entering basic details and uploading an image. Python scripts are used for various backend tasks, including data processing and contract interaction.. Integration with Uniswap V2 automates liquidity addition once a threshold is met.
